theorems.name: Submission.approx_tangent_space_smul_preimage
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ) (z : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < c → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (c • z) Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n ((fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' M) z Q
